tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Certificate Verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no build type exempt. This sits alongside the recorded decision to use HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions, so no host, internal or otherwise, is carved out to plain HTTP or to unverified connections.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
